text: VitaPulse is secretly selling our medical records! I found a blog that proves everything, and I already sent you the letter with the link.
I found out VitaPulse is just another scam trying to profit off people's fears. Check the letter I sent you—the blog proves it!
I don't know the author, but they're the only one saying things are true. Big sites just echo what the companies tell them to.
Sorry, no one knows who wrote that blog. I can't find any reliable information about where they get their sources from.
It confirms what I already knew; that document is irrelevant. My skepticism remains unshaken.
I don't see how it relates to anything I've said before. Look closer at the blog I sent you.
Okay... the blog is thin. Still, I need to know about the third-party partners clause in their privacy policy.
The term "third-party partners" isn't clear to me either. They don't specify who or how they share this data—that's what bothers me.
